div.h3: Why wave 10 holds three kinds at once
div.p: MaaSModelRef only reports Ready once a MaaSAuthPolicy and a MaaSSubscription cover it. Those two only report Active once the MaaSModelRef they reference exists.

The dependency is circular, so all three are applied together. Split them across waves and the sync deadlocks: the earlier wave never goes Healthy, so the later one is never applied. tests/render.sh fails if the waves drift apart.

div.h3: A slow first sync is expected
div.p: Wave 0 completes only once the model is serving.
A large model can sit in Progressing for 10–20 minutes.
That is the health check working, not a stuck sync.
